A.lost: The gap goes unnoticed and the arrangement is taken as complete, so nobody looks for the piece that ought to be there.

B.lost: The exception is filed as noise or damage, and the conditions under which the rule actually works stay unexamined.

C.lost: Details judged dispensable are thrown away and later turn out to carry weight that cannot be reconstructed from memory.

D.lost: The genuinely open question is confused with the merely unexamined one, and effort goes to the wrong side of the fog.

E.lost: The shared structure stays unwitnessed and each partial view is mistaken for the whole room.

F.lost: One interpretation is chosen early and the structure only visible across the unresolved set is hidden without anyone knowing it was there.

G.lost: The response to your probing is read as the object itself, and the undisturbed pattern can no longer be recovered for comparison.

H.lost: The cases stay filed apart and each is solved from scratch, with the one structure behind them never named.

I.lost: Understanding settles into a final view and stops answering new ways of attending, so the structure goes quiet.

J.lost: A pattern your own framing produced is attributed to the object, and everything built on it inherits the mistake unattributed.

K.lost: Understanding remains a summary of known cases and cannot produce a case you have not already seen.

L.lost: The disagreement is smoothed over and the object stays uninvestigated at exactly the point where it would answer.

M.lost: The distinction keeps arriving and keeps slipping away, with no name to hold it until the next occurrence.

N.lost: The hesitations stay filed as incidental texture and the rhythm they form is never heard.

O.lost: The distinction arrives as a fact you can repeat but not as something you can see in your own experience.

P.lost: The wrong turn is discarded whole, taking with it the distinction the successful explanation needed.
